CVE-2026-59313 / CVE-2026-59314 affect Spring Framework 6.2.x (EOL as of 2026-06-30) and are only fixed OSS in Spring Framework 7.0.9 (Spring Boot 4.x), which requires a major-version migration not yet scheduled. Both are Low severity (CVSS 2.6 and 3.1) and require attack paths this application does not use: CVE-2026-59313 requires a WebMvc.fn functional route returning ServerResponse.sse(...) with plain-text (non-JSON) payloads derived from other users' input; CVE-2026-59314 requires building a Content-Disposition header via ContentDisposition.Builder#filename(String, Charset) from unsanitized user-supplied input. This codebase does not use functional SSE routes or user-controlled Content-Disposition filenames. Revisit at the Spring Boot 4 migration.
